tips.li: Use comms console to apply for kiiro work assist.
The storyteller of kiiros will increase the frequency of kiiro events without affecting other events triggering.
Although cannot use transport pods, when there are kiiro towns near your colony, kiiros can respond to your military aid requests.
Most kiiro events will start happening after becoming allies with kiiro faction.
If you were once hostile with the kiiro before becoming allies, it will take them some time to fully trust you.
The paper lanterns used in the kiiro sky Lantern Festival are derived from kiiro paper folding.
Kiiro hunters typically gather in the winter for group hunting to avoid the dangers of venturing out alone during the winter and to stockpile enough game to last the entire season.
